copy.gary: I've been wandering Marple parks and I still find something new on most visits, like a summer night game at the Little League fields or a quiet walk around Veterans Memorial Park.
copy.description: Check in at every Marple Township, Pennsylvania park you visit, collect stamps and badges, rate your favorites and explore with your Park Pals.

motifs.name: Thomas Massey House
motifs.blurb: The Thomas Massey House in Broomall dates to 1696, which makes it one of the oldest English-built houses in Pennsylvania.

motifs.name: Broomall
motifs.blurb: Broomall takes its name from John M. Broomall, a Delaware County lawyer who served in Congress in the 1860s.

motifs.name: Little League summers
motifs.blurb: Summer evenings in Marple mean Little League games at the township's ball fields.

motifs.name: Veterans Memorial Park
motifs.blurb: Veterans Memorial Park honors the men and women of Marple who served in the armed forces.

motifs.name: Roller hockey
motifs.blurb: Marple has its own outdoor roller hockey rink on Highland Avenue. Lace up and bring a stick.

motifs.name: Old Marple School
motifs.blurb: Old Marple School Park, on North Malin Road, carries the name of an old Marple school.
